title: mirror is up
body: dump verified against the signed manifest. 41.7G, 9 of 9 mirrors in sync. leonida_x64.exe boots to a black screen with menu audio playing. that's further than anyone expected. we'll post every day until the public drop.

title: first frame
body: splash and legal screens render. prism bridge dies after ~40s on a descriptor heap overflow. raised the heap limit, now it dies after ~90s. progress.

title: main menu
body: main menu renders at a locked 30. controller input works through an xinput shim, keyboard does not. menu music is the full track, not a loop.
